ambient_events: Behind the curtain, the sink drips rust-brown, then stops.
description: Unit 4C. The realtor — the corkboard downstairs, really — calls this one 'cozy.' It's small. A single room with a curtained-off toilet, a sink that runs rust for a minute before it runs clear, and a window painted shut and then painted again. But the lock is new, the floor is solid, and nobody up here asks questions.
name: Unit 4C
